categories.main_business_segments: Ganzhou Yihao New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: electronic circuit copper foil, aluminum-based copper clad laminate (CCL), and printed circuit boards (PCB). The company focuses on the vertical integration of the PCB industry chain, covering materials research, precision processing, and customized production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs electrolysis technology for copper foil production, including electronic circuit copper foil and lithium battery copper foil. It has developed advanced manufacturing processes such as composite thermal conductive insulating layer production for aluminum-based CCL, ultra-thin insulating layers, and high-precision PCB manufacturing technologies including Mini POB and Micro LED PCB. The company also emphasizes flexible production management to meet diverse customer specifications and maintains strong R&D capabilities with 127 patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international PCB and copper clad laminate manufacturers such as Shengyi Technology, Nanya New Material, and Samsung, as well as brand manufacturers like LG, Gree Electric, TCL, and others. The end markets served span consumer electronics, 5G communications, automotive electronics, industrial control, LED lighting, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates within China, with significant sales in South China, East China, Central China, and Southwest China regions. It also has some overseas sales, though export accounts for a smaller portion of total revenue. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in Ganzhou, Jiangxi Province, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ganzhou Yihao New Materials Co., Ltd. operates primarily upstream and midstream in the electronics materials supply chain. It produces core raw materials such as electronic circuit copper foil and aluminum-based copper clad laminate, and extends downstream into PCB manufacturing, forming a vertically integrated supply chain from base materials to finished PCB products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on expanding high-end electronic circuit copper foil capacity, optimizing product structure, and extending applications into lithium battery copper foil and high-frequency, high-speed copper foil. It emphasizes vertical integration to leverage synergy effects across the copper foil, aluminum-based CCL, and PCB segments. R&D priorities include ultra-thin and ultra-thick copper foil technologies, composite thermal conductive insulating layers, automotive PCB quality control, and Micro LED PCB technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electronic circuit copper foil, aluminum-based copper clad laminate, and PCB products. Pricing for copper foil follows a 'copper price plus processing fee' model, while aluminum-based CCL and PCB prices are negotiated based on production costs and market conditions. The company mainly sells directly to customers with some sales through distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major domestic and international suppliers in the copper foil and PCB industries, including Shengyi Technology, Nanya New Material, and others. It positions itself as a vertically integrated high-tech enterprise with strong R&D capabilities and a comprehensive product matrix, aiming to differentiate through product quality, flexible production, and technological innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.44 billion, a 12.55% increase over the previous year. However, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 38.86 million, reflecting intensified industry competition and ongoing capacity ramp-up in PCB production. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.3 billion, with a slight decline in net assets. It continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ganzhou Yihao New Materials emphasizes its vertically integrated supply chain from copper foil to PCB, enabling rapid product development and cost advantages. Its broad product range covers ultra-thin to ultra-thick copper foils and advanced aluminum-based CCL with superior thermal and electrical properties. The company focuses on high-quality, customized solutions for high-end applications such as AI servers, 5G, automotive electronics, and LED lighting, supported by strong technical certifications and stable customer relationships.
